How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this solution lies in using open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Google Apps Script to host and manage your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic, while Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files, and NOWPayments facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This combination of tools provides a robust and scalable architecture that can be customized to suit your needs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. Whether you're an author selling ebooks, a musician distributing beats, or a software developer offering plugins, this architecture provides a permanent solution to the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors. By building a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can focus on creating value without worrying about platform restrictions or unpredictable payment processing.
You're not limited to a specific platform or payment processor; you can create a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers your online business.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured solution that deploys in 48 hours, featuring Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offer alternative options for creators who want to customize their infrastructure or learn how to deploy it themselves. With these tools, you can create a seamless online store that integrates with your existing workflow.
